name: EventsCalendar.co Events Calendar
author: EventsCalendar.co

sections.description:
EventsCalendar.co is an event management tool designed to elevate your brand’s engagement and event sharing. With features like multiple customizable views, advanced timezone settings for global engagement, and support for various languages, including right-to-left scripts, EventsCalendar.co doesn’t just host your events; it brings them to life in a way that perfectly aligns with your brand’s identity.

Demo

Explore how EventsCalendar.co looks and works in action with our live demo:
https://www.eventscalendar.co/demo

Features

Key Features Include:
– Add one-time or recurring events with daily, weekly or monthly patterns
– Automatically sync with Google Calendar, Eventbrite, Outlook or Zoom
– Customizable design, colors, typography, language, time format, week start, etc.
– Month, Week, Agenda, and Cards views, all customizable to user preferences.
– Community calendar – collect, review and approve events from your visitors.

Whether you’re running a small community group, a large-scale event venue, or anything in between, the EventsCalendar.co plugin makes it easy to keep your visitors informed about upcoming events.

External Services

This plugin relies on several external services to provide its functionality:

EventsCalendar.co Embed Service
– Service: EventsCalendar.co embed script (dist.eventscalendar.co)
– Purpose: Renders the interactive calendar widget on your website
– Data sent: Calendar ID, embed configuration, and user interactions with the calendar
– When: Every time a calendar is displayed on your site (via block, shortcode, or widget)
– Privacy Policy: https://eventscalendar.co/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://eventscalendar.co/terms

EventsCalendar.co API Service
– Service: EventsCalendar.co API (inffuse.eventscalendar.co)
– Purpose: Manages calendar data, user authentication, and calendar synchronization
– Data sent: User ID, site ID, access tokens, calendar configurations, and event data
– When: During plugin configuration, calendar management, and data synchronization
– Privacy Policy: https://eventscalendar.co/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://eventscalendar.co/terms

EventsCalendar.co Dashboard
– Service: EventsCalendar.co dashboard (dashboard.eventscalendar.co)
– Purpose: Provides the admin interface for managing calendars and account settings
– Data sent: User authentication data, site information, and calendar management requests
– When: When accessing the plugin’s admin pages in WordPress dashboard
– Privacy Policy: https://eventscalendar.co/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://eventscalendar.co/terms

Google Fonts and Google Fonts API
– Service: Google Fonts API (www.googleapis.com/webfonts) and Google Fonts (fonts.googleapis.com)
– Purpose: Dynamically fetches the list of popular fonts and loads web fonts for the calendar’s typography in the block editor
– Data sent: API requests for font listings and font requests with basic browser information
– When: During block editor initialization to populate font options and when loading selected fonts
– Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy
– Terms of Service: https://developers.google.com/fonts/terms

Note: The plugin requires an EventsCalendar.co account to function. All calendar data and configurations are managed through EventsCalendar.co services.
sections.changelog:
1.1.1

  • Improved WordPress standards compliance by using proper wp_enqueue functions for scripts and styles
  • Added comprehensive documentation of external services as required by WordPress guidelines
  • Enhanced font loading with dynamic Google Fonts API integration for better typography options

1.1.0

  • Embedding the dashboard without iframe

1.0.1

  • Minor fixes meeting WordPress coding standards.

1.0.0

  • Initial release. Enjoy the plugin!
